title: A T-Fold Black Hole in Doubled Type IIB
summary: We construct an asymptotically flat T-fold representative of a four-dimensional dyonic black-hole charge orbit in doubled type-IIB theory. Starting from the F1-P-NS5-KKM toroidal seed, an integral parabolic T-duality monodromy is imposed on an active doubled three-torus. The non-geometric data enter only through this global patching: the Reissner-Nordström-type term is sourced by conserved four-dimensional electric and magnetic field strengths in the doubled Kaluza-Klein/winding local system, not by an internal algebraic \(Q\)-flux alone.
